name: Wisdom
q: Even a stone bridge, tap before crossing
The falsely clever are the most dangerous
The mind is kindled, not filled
Know others, wisdom; know self, light
Our fault is loving to teach others
Wisdom is knowing what to overlook
Much learning does not teach understanding
Good sense is the most fairly shared
I grow old ever learning many things
Know what you know and what you don't
All things excellent are as difficult as they are rare
